home.title: Sports, water and barbecues surrounded by nature
home.subtitle: Football and tennis courts, pools and barbecue areas to enjoy with family and friends.
home.about: Founded in 2008, the Don Florito Sports Complex was created to offer a space where family and friends could enjoy football in an environment surrounded by nature and tranquility. Over the years, tennis courts, small football fields, pool areas and barbecue areas have been added, to keep offering the family-friendly and entertaining atmosphere that defines the complex.

servicesPage.title: Our services
servicesPage.subtitle: Pick your plan and book online.

canchas.title: Football fields and mini football
canchas.tagline: Natural grass, shade and great atmosphere.

sections.title: Enjoy football in a unique natural setting
sections.body: Our natural grass fields offer an unparalleled playing experience. The grass is always well kept and in perfect condition, so you can play comfortably and safely.

sections.title: Natural environment
sections.body: The fields are surrounded by trees that provide shade and coolness during the game. The stands let you rest and enjoy the landscape after the match.

sections.title: Ideal for all ages
sections.body: Whether you are a professional or an amateur, you can enjoy football in a pleasant, family-friendly environment.

canchas.note: The complex does not have lighting for night games.

sections.title: Clay courts
sections.body: Clay is slower than concrete, giving you more time to react and to play more elaborate points. It also offers better grip and reduces impact on the joints.

sections.title: Tradition and prestige
sections.body: Clay courts are used in the world's most important tournaments, such as Roland Garros. Playing on one lets you feel the same excitement as the best players in the world.

sections.title: Variety for every taste
sections.body: We have 5 pools and trampolines: 2 adult pools (ideal for swimming, relaxing and sunbathing), 2 children's pools with reduced depth, 1 pool exclusively for women in a private and quiet setting, and trampolines so kids can jump and have fun nonstop.

sections.title: All the comforts
sections.body: All pools include access to changing rooms and restrooms. There are also grassy areas to relax in the sun, surrounded by the complex's flora and fauna.

quinchos.title: Barbecue areas

sections.title: Privileged location
sections.body: Our barbecue areas are in both the pool zone and the courts zone. Enjoy the landscape, the trees and the native birds while sharing a barbecue with friends and family.

sections.title: Fully equipped
sections.body: Each one has a grill, sink, light, benches, trash cans and a table, ready for your arrival.

quinchos.note: Maximum capacity per barbecue area is 10 people.
